age_limit: Not less than 18 years of age as on the first day of January of the recruitment year i.e., 01.01.2026 and not more than 30 years of age on the last day of submission of Application Form. selection_process: The examinations for the concerned posts will be held in the following manner viz., Written Examination, Practical Test, followed by Interview / viva-voce. Candidates securing 40% or more marks in the Written Examination shall be eligible to appear in the Practical Test. Candidates securing 40% or more marks in the Practical Test shall be eligible to appear in the Interview / Viva-Voce. Final selection will be made on the basis of the combined marks secured by the candidates in the Written Examination, Practical Test and Interview / viva-voce. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of over-all performance of the candidates.
